title: Coordinate covectors dx^I = det(v_j(I k)) exist and span
statement: For all P, n ∈ ℕ: (a) for every I : Fin n → Fin P there is an n-covector θ on ℝ^P with θ(v) = det(v_j(I k))_{k,j} for every v : Fin n → ℝ^P, i.e. the determinant of the n×n matrix Matrix.of fun k j => v j (I k); (b) let ζ be an n-vector (MultiVector P n, a continuous linear functional on n-covectors) such that ζ(θ) = 0 whenever I : Fin n → Fin P is strictly increasing and θ is an n-covector with θ(v) = det(v_j(I k))_{k,j} for all v; then ζ = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ), (∀ I : Fin n → Fin P, ∃ θ : Covector (Euclid P) n, ∀ v : Fin n → Euclid P, θ v = Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun k j => v j (I k))) ∧ ∀ ζ : MultiVector P n, (∀ (I : Fin n → Fin P) (θ : Covector (Euclid P) n), StrictMono I → (∀ v : Fin n → Euclid P, θ v = Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun k j => v j (I k))) → ζ θ = 0) → ζ = 0
